title: How credit card issuers and reservation apps like OpenTable and Amex-owned Resy fragment restaurant reservations, wiring the best tables into premium card perks (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: How credit card issuers and reservation apps like OpenTable and Amex-owned Resy fragment restaurant reservations, wiring the best tables into premium card perks — After a flurry of deals, new apps, membership clubs and other middlemen are fighting over access to high-spending customers and the eateries they love
